02 / BEHIND THE BUILD

AI in the workflow.
Human at the wheel.

This portfolio is an open experiment in human-directed, AI-assisted development. You can inspect the brief, the decisions, and the implementation in the repository.

Open the development record ↗
  1. 01

    Set the direction.

    Human brief: reinterpret a game publisher's experience as a personal portfolio, with evidence behind the claims.

  2. 02

    Build with assistance.

    AI helps research, design, and implement. Source links and an isolated feature branch make the work inspectable.

  3. 03

    Verify. Review. Refine.

    Check interactions and responsive layouts, document limits, then bring the result back for human review.
